problem_statement: The MQTT-SN client cannot update the will topic or will message after the initial connection. A user who changes client->will_topic or client->will_msg after connecting has no way to push the new value to the server. The library should provide functions to send a will topic update and a will message update to the gateway: each call returns success (or a negative errno), returns -EALREADY if an update of the same kind is already in progress, sends the corresponding WILLTOPICUPD/WILLMSGUPD message to the gateway, and on receiving an accepted WILLTOPICRESP/WILLMSGRESP clears the in-progress state so a subsequent update can be issued. A will topic update should send the topic name, retain flag, and QoS; setting the topic size to zero should send an empty will topic update.

A will topic update should send the topic name, retain flag, and QoS; setting the topic size to zero should send an empty will topic update.
